Title: CREATE CUSTOM BUTTON TEXTURE: Apply Custom Button Texture
Content: Objective Apply custom button texture to buttons in Marvelous Designer. Location Property Editor Material Diffuse Map Operation Navigate to Object Browser Button Tab and select the button item to be edited. The button item's properties appear in the Property Editor. Follow the indicated guideline below: Property Editor Material Diffuse Map The file browser appears. Locate and select the custom button texture and select Open. The custom button texture is applied to the selected button item.

Title: BUTTON STYLE PROPERTIES: Button Weight
Content: Objective Enter weight value for buttons to simulate as desired. Location Object Browser Button Tab Property Editor Weight Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: Object Browser Select a button item in the Button Tab. Its properties appear in the Property Editor. Enter desired weight value in gram. The button weight is now being adjusted and applied when simulating.

Title: Create 2D Button Measurement
Content: Objective View button position from the Pattern outline with 2D measurements (ver2.5.0). Location Object Browser Button Property Editor 2D Measurements To Center Operation Select a button with Select/Move Button tool in the 3D toolbar. Follow the indicated guideline below: Object Browser Button Property Editor 2D Measurements To Center Select the desired 2D measurement options of the left/right/up/down. The 2D measurement is now being displayed or hidden accordingly.

Title: Create Button
Content: Objective Create buttons and place them as desired. Location Main Menu Materials Button Button 3D Toolbar Button Operation Create Button Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu Materials Button Button 3D Toolbar Button Click on a desired point on the 3D Garment or 2D Pattern. A button is now being created at the designated location. Input Measurement for Button Position Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu Materials Button Button 3D Toolbar Button Right-click on the 2D Pattern where buttons would be placed. Moving Distance window appears. Input desired measurements for accurate placement. Placement preview depending on the input value displays along the mouse in the 2D window. Click OK to place. The buttons are now being created.

Title: Show/Hide Button
Content: Objective Show or hide all buttons and buttonholes. Location 3D Garment Window 3D Garment Display (Mouse-over) Show Button Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: 3D Garment Window 3D Garment Display (Mouse-over) Show Button All buttons and buttonholes are now being hidden. Follow the indicated guideline once again. All hidden buttons and buttonholes are now being displayed.

Title: Button Property Setting
Content: Objective Adjust button properties in the Property Editor. Location Main Menu Materials Button Select/Move Button 3D Toolbar Select/Move Button Explanation Selecting a button with Select/Move or Select/Move Button tool displays its properties in the Property Editor. Button Property Description Angle Enter desired value for rotation angle of buttons. Thread Length (cm) Enter desired value for thread length in centimeter (cm) from the range of 0.00~1.00. Style Select a button style. Collision Set ON/OFF for collision option. Set it OFF in order to fix its location to avoid the collision between the buttons and the Patterns. 2D Measurements View the position of buttons in 2D Pattern with its size measurement. Set check-boxes On for Left/Right/Up/Down as desired. The 2D size measurements appear accordingly. Polygon Optimization Count Set the number of polygons. Plane This is applied in the form of a texture when the Plane is activated. Count cannot be set on Plane activation.

Title: Move Button
Content: Objective Move buttons as desired. Location Main Menu Materials Button Select/Move Button 3D Toolbar Select/Move Button Operation Move Buttons with Click-and-Drag Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu Materials Button Select/Move Button 3D Toolbar Select/Move Button Click and drag the buttons to the desired location on either of 2D or 3D Pattern. The selected buttons are now being moved accordingly. Move Buttons with Distance Input (ver2.5.0) Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu Materials Button Select/Move Button 3D Toolbar Select/Move Button While click and dragging the buttons with left-click mouse button, click right-click mouse button in either of 2D or 3D window. The Moving Distance window appears. Enter desired value in the menu. Distance Moved Sets the moved distance of the buttonhole from its original location. Position Sets the position of the center of the buttonhole from the left/right/top/bottom of the Pattern outline. Click OK. The buttonholes are now being moved according to the input value. Note : It is able to select and move multiple buttons at once in the 2D window (ver2.4.0). The Gizmo for Select/Move Button tool has been changed from 2D rotation Gizmo to 3D translocation Gizmo (ver3.1.0).

Title: Copy/Paste Button
Content: Objective Copy and paste multiple buttons with keeping the interval space evenly or to Symmetric Patterns. Location Main Menu Materials Button Select/Move Button 3D Toolbar Select/Move Button Operation Copy/Paste Button Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu Materials Button Select/Move Button 3D Toolbar Select/Move Button Right click on an existing button, then select Copy (Ctrl+C). Right click the same button again, then select Paste (Ctrl+V). Click on a desired place to locate the copy of the button. Input Interval/Number/Position to Copy/Paste Button Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu Materials Button Select/Move Button 3D Toolbar Select/Move Button Right click on an existing button, then select Copy (Ctrl+C). Right click the same button again, then select Paste (Ctrl+V). Right click on a desired place to locate the copy of the button. The Paste window appears. Input desired value for Interval, Number of Buttons, and Position. Interval Sets the distance between buttons. Number of Buttons/Buttonholes Sets the number of buttons to copy/paste. Position Sets the position of the center of the copied button/buttonhole from the left/right/top/bottom of the pattern outline (ver2.5.0). Click OK. The buttons are now being created and applied accordingly. Duplicate Button to Symmetric Pattern Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu Materials Button Select/Move Button 3D Toolbar Select/Move Button Select a button to duplicate. The selected button is now being highlighted in yellow color. Right click on the selected button. Pop-up menu appears. Select Duplicate to Symmetric Pattern from the menu. The selected button is now being duplicated at the same level.

Title: Button List Window
Content: When creating a button, The Default Button is applied as default setting and displayed in the button list window. Once the Default Button style is modified, it lasts until rerun of the program and it is unable to be deleted.

Title: Button Right-Click Menus
Content: Objective Change status of buttons as desired. Location 3D Toolbar Select/Move Button Pop-up Menu (Right-click 3D/2D Button) Main Menu Materials Button Select/Move Button 3D Toolbar Select/Move Pop-up Menu (Right-click 3D/2D Button) Operation Follow the indicated guideline: 3D Toolbar Select/Move Button Pop-up Menu (Right-click 3D/2D Button) Main Menu Materials Button Select/Move Button 3D Toolbar Select/Move Pop-up Menu (Right-click 3D/2D Button) Right-click on the button to edit. Button related pop-up menu appears. Pop-up Menu Description Reset 3D Position Reset to location of pre-simulation. Copy Copy the selected button. Paste Paste the selected button. Mirror Paste (Position Only) Mirror paste the position of the selected button. Delete Delete the selected button. Duplicate to Symmetric Pattern Duplicate the selected button to its symmetric pattern. Activate/Deactivate Activate or deactivate the selected button. Freeze/Unfreeze Freeze or unfreeze the selected button. Set Number of Sewing Layers Set the number of sewing layers for the selected button. After setting the Number of Sewing Layers, use the Select/Move Button tool to adjust buttons' locations on each Patterns. Flip Move the selected button to the opposite side. Align Align selected buttons based on the selected options. Distribute Distribute selected buttons horizontally or vertically with same intervals

Title: Mirror Paste Button
Content: Objective Copy and mirror paste buttons (ver2.5.0). Location Main Menu Materials Button Select/Move Button Button Right-Click Pop-Up Menu Mirror Paste (Ctrl+R) 3D Toolbar Select/Move Button Button Right-Click Pop-Up Menu Mirror Paste (Ctrl+R) Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu Materials Button Select/Move Button Button Right-Click Pop-Up Menu Mirror Paste (Ctrl+R) 3D Toolbar Select/Move Button Button Right-Click Pop-Up Menu Mirror Paste (Ctrl+R) Click Copy (Ctrl+C) from the pop-up menu. Right click on the copied button then click Mirror Paste (Ctrl+R) from the pop-up menu. Placement preview displays along the mouse in the 2D window. Click on a desired location to paste the buttons. Note: Before pasting buttons in place, right-click to access the Paste window where specific interval and number of buttons can be manually input for multiple copy and paste. When buttons are mirror-pasted, only locations are mirrored whereas other properties, such as Angle, are not.

Title: Duplicate as Buttonhole to Symmetric Pattern
Content: Objective Duplicate buttons as buttonholes, or buttonholes as buttons, to its Symmetric Pattern. Location Main Menu Materials Button Select/Move Button 3D Toolbar Select/Move Button Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu Materials Button Select/Move Button 3D Toolbar Select/Move Button Click on the button or buttonhole to be duplicated to its Symmetric Pattern. The selected button or buttonhole is highlighted in yellow. Right-click on the selected button or buttonhole. The right-click pop-up menu appears. Depending on the selected item, select Duplicate as Button to Symmetric Pattern or Duplicate as Buttonhole to Symmetric Pattern. The selected button or buttonhole is duplicated as a buttonhole or button, depending on the selected item, to its Symmetric Pattern.

Title: Delete Button Style
Content: Objective Delete unnecessary button styles. Location Object Browser Button Tab Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: Object Browser Button Tab Select a button style to be deleted. Press Delete on keyboard or right click on the button style and select Delete option. The selected button style is not deleted.

Title: Copy Button Style
Content: Objective Copy and modify a button in order to create a new button style or adjust its properties. Location Object Browser Button Tab Copy Operation Object Browser Select an item in the button tab. Follow the indicated guideline below: Object Browser Button Tab Copy A new button item with the same properties of the selected item is now being created.

Title: Reset Button Style Property
Content: Objective Reset button item properties to default value (ver2.5.0). Location Object Browser Button Tab Right-Click Button Item Pop-Up Menu Reset Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: Object Browser Button Tab Right-Click Button Item Pop-Up Menu Reset The button item properties are now being reset back to default value.

Title: Apply Button Style
Content: Objective Apply button styles onto buttons as desired. Location Object Browser Button Tab Operation Apply Button Style In Property Editor Click on a button and select a button style in the Property Editor. The selected button style is now being applied to the button. Select A Button And Apply Button Style Select a button. Follow the indicated guideline below: Object Browser Button Tab Assigned to Selected Patterns The button style is now being applied to the selected button. Select A Button And Apply A New Button Style Select a button. Follow the indicated guideline below: Object Browser Button Tab Assigned to New Fabric A new buttonhole style is now being added to the buttonhole list window and applied at the same time.

Title: Create Additional Button Style
Content: Objective Create a new button style. Location Object Browser Button Tab Add Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: Object Browser Button Tab Add A new item named after 'Button 1, 2' is now being created and applied.

Title: Create Buttonholes along Pattern Outline (Ver. 5.1)
Content: Objective Create buttonholess along a Pattern Outline in a constant interval and distance. Location Main Menu Materials Button Buttonhole 3D Toolbar Buttonhole Operation Create Follow the indicated path below: Main Menu Materials Button Buttonhole 3D Toolbar Buttonhole Right click on a Pattern Outline. The Create Buttons/Buttonholes along Pattern Outline window appears. Note: To select multiple lines, press down the Shift key and click the lines to be selected. Configure below options as needed: Start Position Distance Set the distance between the buttonholes and the selected line. Interval Set the distance between the buttonholes and the Pattern Outline. Reverse The direction of which buttonholes are created is reversed to the Start Point. Replicate Interval Adjust the distance between the buttonholes. Number of Button/Buttonholes Adjust the number of buttonholes to be created. Click OK. Buttonholes are created as a group. Select Follow the indicated path below: Main Menu Materials Button Select/Move Button 3D Toolbar Select/Move Button Click on a buttonhole or a Pattern Outline where buttonholes are created. All buttonholes in a group are selected. Note: Click again while the group of buttonholes are selected to select a single buttonhole. Change selected buttonholes' properties or style or use right-click pop-up menu. Any changes made are applied to all buttonholes in the same group. Group information cannot be copied or duplicated. A pop-up menu is available when right-clicking above the group line with the buttonhole tool. Note: Grouped buttonholes cannot be moved. Unlink Follow the indicated path below: Main Menu Materials Button Select/Move Button 3D Toolbar Select/Move Button Right click on the buttonholes or the Pattern Outline and select Unlink Buttons/Buttonholes. The link between the buttonholes are removed.

Title: Texture Stitch (Above ver. 11)
Content: Texture Stitch 기능 추가 Texture Stitch feature add 스티치 노말맵을 사용 및 베이킹 하기 위해서 Texture Stitch 기능을 추가합니다. Add Texture Stitch feature in order to either use or bake the stitch normal map.

Title: Seamline Topstitch (ver MD10)
Content: Objective Create a Seamline Topstitch. Location Main Menu Materials Topstitch Seamline Topstitch 2D Toolbar Seamline Topstitch Operation Follow the indicated guideline above. All sewing lines on the Pattern are displayed. Click on a point where a Topstitch begins. Move mouse to the direction where the Topstitch is going to be created. Click on another point where the Topstitch ends. The Topstitch is now being created with being highlighted. Note: Click and drag in the 2D window to encompass all segments where Topstitches to be applied. Topstitches appear on all selected segments. Use lasso selection to select Pattern Outlines and Internal Lines where Topstitches should be created on. OBJ Topstitches temporarily disappear when the Simulation is activated, but they appear again when the Simulation is deactivated. Right click when creating the Topstitch to enter specific length.

Title: TOPSTITCH STYLE PROPERTIES: Topstitch Thread Thickness
Content: Objective Adjust the Thread Thickness in the desired measurement unit. Location Object Browser Topstitch Topstitch Property Editor Thread Thickness Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: Object Browser Topstitch Topstitch Property Editor Thread Thickness Adjust the Thread Thickness with the desired unit of measurement.

Title: TOPSTITCH STYLE PROPERTIES: Apply Topstitch Texture
Content: Objective Change texture type for Topstitch(es). Note : Texture can only be applied when the type is selected for Texture in the Property Editor. Location Property Editor Texture Search Operation Object Browser Select a Topstitch to add texture image. The selected Topstitch is now being highlighted. Follow the indicated guideline below: Topstitch Property Editor Texture Search The Open File window appears. Select and open desired texture image file. The selected image is now being applied to the selected Topstitch. Note : Not like fabrics, texture image file cannot be applied by Drag &amp Drop for Topstitch.

Title: TOPSTITCH STYLE PROPERTIES: Topstitch Offset
Content: Objective Adjust the interval between Topstitches on Internal Lines or Pattern outlines. Location Object Browser Topstitch Topstitch Property Editor Offset Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: Object Browser Topstitch Topstitch Property Editor Offset Adjust the interval. The value is now being adjusted and applied.

Title: TOPSTITCH STYLE PROPERTIES: Apply Normal Map to Topstitch
Content: Objective Apply Normal Maps to Topstitches for more realistic visualization. Location Object Browser Topstitch Tab Property Editor Topstitch Texture Normal Map Operation Topstitch Normal Map Follow the indicated guideline below: Object Browser Topstitch Tab Property Editor Topstitch Texture Normal Map The intensity value range of -10 to 10 can be applied automatically as entered. The higher the value, the bumpier expression of top-stitches, the less the value, the less bumpier expression of top-stitches. Apply Topstitch Normal Map Image Follow the indicated guideline below: Object Browser Topstitch Tab Property Editor Topstitch Texture Normal Map Click on the Search button. Select and load desired texture image file. The selected image is now being applied. Note: Applying method for Topstitch Normal Map is the same as Fabric Texture Normal Map.

Title: TOPSTITCH STYLE PROPERTIES: Topstitch Default Color Setting
Content: Objective Set Topstitch default color in order to change the color. Location Object Browser Topstitch Tab Topstitch Item Property Editor Material Color Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: Object Browser Topstitch Tab Topstitch Item Property Editor Material Color The Color palette window appears. Select color as desired. Note: The Eyedropper allows to extract color not only from Marvelous Designer but any other websites or images by simply clicking on the desired color. The extracted colors can also be added and saved in the color palette.

Title: TOPSTITCH STYLE PROPERTIES: Rename Topstitch
Content: Objective Rename Topstitches. Location Property Editor Rename Operation Object Browser Select a Topstitch style to rename. Its properties appear in the Property Editor. Follow the indicated guideline below: Property Editor Rename The name is now being changed and applied.

Title: TOPSTITCH STYLE PROPERTIES: Topstitch Style Preset
Content: Objective Utilize the provided Topstitch presets to quickly visualize a variety of Topstitch styles. Location Property Editor Stitch Preset Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: Property Editor Stitch Preset Based on the chart below, select the desired preset. The selected Topstitch changes based on the choice. Custom Use the Custom preset to input the desired values for the Topstitch style. Bartack Buttonhole Single Overlock Pickstitch Zigzag Note: If any individual setting is changed after a provided preset is selected, the Preset automatically changes to Custom. You can select either Texture or OBJ from the Type menu in the Property Editor. (Ver. 11)

Title: TOPSTITCH STYLE PROPERTIES: Number of Topstitch Line Setting
Content: Objective Set how many lines of Topstitches there are for a single style. Location Object Browser Topstitch Tab Property Editor Number of Lines Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: Object Browser Topstitch Tab Property Editor Number of Lines Enter the number of lines as desired. The Number of Lines is now being adjusted and applied. Note : Distance of Number of Lines It is possible to adjust the distance between the lines.

Title: TOPSTITCH STYLE PROPERTIES: Topstitch Face Setting
Content: Objective Select the face of Topstitch. Location Object Browser Topstitch Topstitch Property Editor Face Explanation Topstitch is only set for the front of the Fabric. Topstitch is only set for the back of the Fabric. Topstitch is set for the both sides of the Fabric. Note: Topstitch placed on the back of the Fabric do not appear in the 2D window (ver4.2.0).

Title: TOPSTITCH PROPERTIES: Flip Topstitch
Content: Objective Use the Flip function to set a Topstitch on an Internal Shape/Line in a different direction (inside and outside). When setting the Topstitch on the Pattern's cutting line, the Topstitches always appear on the inside of a Garment and the Flip function gets deactivated. Location Property Editor Placement Flip Operation Select a Topstitch with Edit Topstitch tool in the 2D window for changing its properties. Topstitch properties appear on the Property Editor. Follow the indicated guideline below: Property Editor Placement Flip The Topstitch direction will now be changed.
